notes: GSC cross-dimension long-term library (migration 029) plus decision-join views (no extra migration). (1) Migration 029 adds gsc_dimension_facts, a single fact table with generic dimension slots (query/page/country/device, each NOT NULL DEFAULT '') carrying the page_country / page_device / query_country GSC datasets as a read-only projection of the immutable on-disk snapshots, mirroring 028 gsc_search_terms: FORCE RLS + organization predicate, per-dataset CHECK constraints, idempotent upsert. 029 is purely additive (CREATE TABLE/index/policy only, no ALTER of existing tables), so there is no ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock and no orphan-row risk; a rollback to v0.2.13 keeps running because the older image simply never reads the new table. Ingest is wired into the tenant growth runner (failure only records quality, never blocks collection); a one-off `pnpm gsc:dimensions:backfill` rebuilds from disk. The growth insights split card is replaced by a date-range view over the fact table (query_page keeps living in the /growth/terms keyword library). (2) Three decision-join views on top of that library, all read-layer only: a page_country region rollup that aggregates countries into TargetMarket regions (single-source country->region map in shared-types; East Asia and uncovered countries stay explicitly unmapped, never forced) and neutrally reconciles observed organic traffic against the site's declared target markets from its latest report; a page_device per-page desktop-vs-mobile gap; and a query_country per-region top-queries view. Coverage stays detail_top_rows, CTR/position are impression-weighted, missing days are never zero-filled. No new migration for part (2).
